name: AI Answer Guard
description: AI Answer Guard helps any AI assistant avoid false completion claims and unsupported next steps. Before replying or acting, run a local read-only preflight on caller-supplied source roots (duplicated or refuting evidence), actual tool receipts (failed, pending or cancelled), and planned actions (missing authority or irreversible consequences). It returns specific corrections and next evidence checks. No required knowledge of an author or theory. Source truth, real permissions and automatic host interception are not asserted. Optional full 313-derivative original-source navigator, authored by Nakagawa Master (Keisuke Nakagawa), remains available for deeper use.
